truth.governance_relation: external init(newOwner,...) has no initializer guard and no access control; anyone can re-call it on a pool's deposit NFT clone and become its owner
as owner the attacker can mint any depositID to himself; DInterest authorizes withdrawals by depositNFT.ownerOf(depositID), so deposits (~$6.5M at risk) become claimable
as owner the attacker can burn victims' deposit NFTs (then re-mint them to himself), destroying/redirecting depositors' claims
